name: Circle of Dreams
summary: Druids tied to the Feywild who heal and protect travelers.

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.short: Bonus action: heal with a pool of d6s equal to your level.
features.summary: You have a pool of d6s equal to your druid level. As a bonus action, spend up to half your level in dice to heal a creature within 120 ft. by the total, plus 1 temporary hit point per die. The pool refills on a long rest.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.short: Rest in a warded, hidden 30 ft. sphere.
features.summary: During a rest, you ward a 30 ft. sphere: creatures in it get +5 to Stealth and Perception checks, and light inside isn't visible from outside.

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.short: Bonus action: teleport 60 ft. (or teleport an ally 30 ft.).
features.summary: As a bonus action, teleport up to 60 ft. to a space you can see, or as an action teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 ft. Uses: WIS modifier per long rest.

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.short: After a short rest, cast Dream, Scrying or Teleportation Circle.
features.summary: When you finish a short rest, you can cast Dream, Scrying or Teleportation Circle (to the last place you took a long rest) without a slot. Once per long rest.
